news.title: Telangana speeds up GO 59 land regularisation, collectors told to clear backlog
news.para: The Telangana government is urging district collectors to swiftly handle the backlog of land regularisation applications. Revenue Minister Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy highlighted the necessity of meticulous verification prior to any approvals. This strategic initiative seeks to alleviate the persistent difficulties encountered by applicants dealing with encroached government lands.

news.title: NGT directs Chennai civic body to ensure strict adherence by builders to construction waste rules
news.para: The National Green Tribunal directed the Greater Chennai Corporation to maintain uninterrupted processing of construction waste. It was noted that facilities for this purpose stopped functioning in early 2024, highlighting an essential need for alternative solutions. The tribunal mandated that compliance with waste management guidelines must be integral to building-plan approvals.

news.title: Gurugram: DTCP seals five buildings in Sushant Lok-1 for commercial use of residential premises
news.para: In Sushant Lok-1, the Department of Town and Country Planning embarked on a significant operation aimed at enforcing local regulations. During the initiative, five buildings were sealed due to their unauthorized commercial activities within residential areas. This included two paying guest accommodations and a guest house, underscoring a continuous commitment to curbing such breaches. District town planner Amit Madholia highlighted the ongoing nature of these enforcement actions.

news.title: Telangana fire services revises fire safety rules for provisional fire NOCs
news.para: The Fire, Disaster Response, Emergency and Civil Defence Department of Telangana has updated its Fire and Life Safety protocols, focusing on provisional fire No Objection Certificates. This revision is designed to bolster safety measures statewide. One key change includes raising the height threshold for residential buildings from 18 meters to 24 meters. These new stipulations are set to be enforced from October 7 for all incoming applications.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh bets on easier building norms to drive growth
news.para: The State cabinet has greenlit the Model Building Regulations 2026, which are geared towards facilitating industrial development. This strategic move aims to streamline building plan approvals, thereby optimizing land use throughout the state. By fostering transparency for investors and citizens alike, these regulations are poised to stimulate growth in manufacturing and tourism, ultimately upgrading urban infrastructure and availability of quality housing.

news.title: Villa project in Koheda village thrives despite three notices over feeder channel encroachment
news.para: After numerous inspections and notices, a villa project in Koheda village persists in its construction activities over the past year. It reportedly encroaches on three feeder channels and lacks necessary permits. Various violations have been noted during joint inspections, including risky construction in flood-prone zones. Concerned local residents voiced their worries during a government program, but action from authorities to stop the construction remains absent despite these issues.

news.title: Amrapali homebuyers’ money trail leads to ₹54.71 crore Delhi property; ED attaches asset
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has attached a property in Maharani Bagh connected to the Amrapali Group's alleged financial misconduct. Investigations revealed that significant funds collected from homebuyers were allegedly misappropriated by the group's promoters. A forensic audit indicated that over Rs 5,000 crore had been diverted from the intended projects. The attached property is identified as proceeds of crime related to this investigation.

news.title: Fix infrastructure before building high: Residents to Chandigarh administration
news.para: Chandigarh citizens are raising alarm over proposed amendments to the Master Plan that would allow for higher-density housing. Key concerns include the strain on infrastructure, worsening traffic conditions, and ecological impacts in the city. Areas like Maloya and Manimajra are particularly contested for new developments. Local stakeholders argue that infrastructural enhancements must precede any plans for taller structures.

news.title: Kolkata civic body announces property tax waiver scheme, 100% interest, 99% penalty to be exempt
news.para: The Kolkata Municipal Corporation is set to roll out an interest waiver scheme for property tax defaulters starting this Friday. Those who clear their dues by March 31 will benefit from a 100% interest waiver, while additional waivers will be available for mixed-use and commercial properties. This initiative is part of KMC's strategy to recover Rs 884 crore in unpaid taxes amid recent dips in revenue collection.

news.title: DPCC issues show-cause notices to agencies over dust control violations at construction sites in Delhi
news.para: The Delhi Pollution Control Committee has taken action by issuing notices to construction operators that failed to manage dust emissions effectively. Several projects, including those by Delhi Jal Board and Delhi Metro, did not comply with pollution regulations. The government stresses the importance of regular inspections and ensures that all involved parties are held accountable, suggesting fines or work stoppages as possible corrective measures.

news.title: Kalpataru pre-sales fall 5% to ₹1,258 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Kalpataru reported pre-sales of ₹1,258 crore in Q2 FY27, down 5% year-on-year, while collections remained broadly flat at ₹1,189 crore. For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at ₹2,587 crore and collections increased 9% to ₹2,554 crore.

news.title: Ajmera Realty sales value falls 69% to ₹224 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Ajmera Realty & Infra India reported sales value of ₹224 crore in Q2 FY27, down 69% year-on-year, while collections declined 14% to ₹190 crore. For H1 FY27, sales value fell 55% to ₹370 crore and collections declined 20% to ₹363 crore.

news.title: Delhi government to inspect 100 PGs, considers mandatory CCTV backup under proposed rules
news.para: In an initiative to enhance the safety of student housing, the Delhi government plans to inspect 100 paying guest accommodations to verify compliance with safety and legal standards. They are considering mandated CCTV installations for further security. An online platform is in development to register and map these accommodations, while a sub-committee will review regulations affecting their legal operation near educational institutions.

news.title: Noida Sports City: Revised master plan approved, four projects get conditional occupancy certificates
news.para: The Noida Authority has green-lighted an updated master plan for the Sports City initiative in Sector 150, following board meetings on January 3 and April 6. A public notice prompted community feedback. The plan dedicates 70% for sports and recreation, while 29.5% addresses residential needs. Additionally, four projects have secured conditional occupancy certificates after clearing dues, with the Supreme Court reviewing compliance and safeguarding homebuyers' rights.

news.title: WeWork India leases 1.61 lakh sq ft in Pune; plans ₹44 crore investment
news.para: WeWork India has entered into a leave and licence agreement for 1.61 lakh sq ft of space in Pune, which will add approximately 2,881 desks to its portfolio. The new capacity is expected to become operational by July 2027.

news.title: Pune: PMC cracks down on potable water use at construction sites, pushes developers to only use treated water
news.para: Pune Municipal Corporation has mandated that all construction developers use treated water in lieu of potable water. This directive follows concerns over water scarcity due to reduced rainfall during an El Niño year. Many developers have already adopted this approach and are promoting awareness within their organizations. The civic administration is also monitoring compliance closely and taking action against any violations.

news.title: Acquire Harnandipuram land only through talks: HC to Ghaziabad development body
news.para: The Allahabad high court affirmed that land for the Harnandipuram township cannot be acquired unlawfully, ensuring legal compliance. Landowners expressed concerns about fair compensation rates amid low circle rates set by authorities. The Ghaziabad Development Authority plans to proceed through mutual negotiation despite earlier moves toward compulsory acquisition. The project aims to develop 521 hectares across several villages with costs shared by the state government.

news.title: Delhi to conduct slum survey after 12 years, expands rehabilitation net
news.para: In an effort to enhance housing solutions, the Delhi government is set to embark on a new survey of slum areas and JJ clusters within the next few weeks. The goal is to accurately identify those eligible for the Jahan Jhuggi, Wahan Makan rehabilitation initiative. By extending the cut-off date for slum recognition, officials anticipate a higher count of households.

news.title: DTCP restarts drive to seal & raze illegal Sushant Lok buildings in Gurugram
news.para: The Department of Town and Country Planning has taken strong enforcement measures in Sushant Lok-1's B Block. They sealed seven properties for engaging in unauthorized commercial activities and operating PG accommodations. As part of their crackdown, illegal constructions within stilt areas and basements were also demolished. Inspections will persist in the coming days to uphold planning standards and address reported violations.

news.title: About 25,000 property registrations at Gurugram tehsil office have one fictitious PAN
news.para: An income-tax investigation in Badshapur tehsil has exposed major fraudulent activity involving a sham PAN used for property registrations. In just two years, approximately 25,000 properties have been connected to this bogus PAN, leading to the discovery of over 35,000 transactions that were misreported or not reported at all, totaling an estimated Rs 55,000 crore in value.
